dct_description_sm: This dataset contains high-resolution seasonal and spatial depth profiles of dissolved copper (dCu) speciation parameters in seawater samples collected from the Strait of Georgia, between September 2017 to August 2018.
dct_title_s: Seasonal and Spatial Depth Profiles of Dissolved Copper Speciation in the Strait of Georgia
